This is the text half of the card. PR #34422 carries its code half; this PR changes no code, no spec and no test.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:打印页文档 `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` 与已发布技能 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 各加一句:分节可能跨页的打印页,每一节单独写一个 `record:details` 块。
- **为什么改**:`avoidBreakInside` 让每个块整块落在一张纸上,装了多节的一个大块会整块挪到下一张纸,第一张留下大片空白;维护者裁决 6922479414 保留规则含义不变,改为拆开模板。
- **风险与回滚**:只改文档与技能文字,不动代码、规格与测试;回滚即 revert 本 PR。技能文件为守住 token 上限(上限未动),删掉了一句已过时的「控制台打印渲染尚未上线」说法、一处重复的「, in full」,以及 Docs「Routing model」段里一个重复短语;react 页 Safety / availability 段保持与 main 逐字一致。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 的 Print pages 段(新增句 + 删掉的过时句)与 Routing model 段一处删减;② `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` 键表下方的新段;③ `.changeset/34228-print-section-per-block.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:运行 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `✓ … 57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`(pages.md 5666 / 上限 5669,上限未动)。
- **需要你做的**:席位按 Tier H(`skills/**`)移交维护者审批合并。

## What changes

- `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx`: one sentence under the print key table. On a print page whose sections may break between sheets, author one `record:details` block per section, because `avoidBreakInside` keeps each block whole on one sheet when it fits, so a block holding several sections moves to the next sheet as one piece. "When it fits" matches the describe of `print.avoidBreakInside` in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`. The rule itself is unchanged (`break-inside: avoid` on every block).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`, § Print pages: the same guidance in one sentence after the page-break hints, in the file's compact voice. The `avoidBreakInside` gloss now reads "keep each block whole on one sheet when it fits", the spec describe's qualifier, because a block taller than one sheet still breaks inside itself.
- The skill file sits on a token ceiling with zero headroom (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: 5669, measured 5668 on `main`), so the sentence is paid for by deleting content, the ceiling is not raised:
  - dropped the sentence "Validated today; the console's print rendering that applies it follows, so `os validate` warns the layout is not yet applied." It no longer holds: every `print.*` describe in `page.zod.ts` says "Applied by the console's browser print rendering", and `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` records every `print` key as `live`;
  - dropped the words ", in full" from "must draw all it declares, in full,". They only repeated "all it declares", and the "draws a window of its rows" refusal in the same paragraph still covers a block that draws part of its rows;
  - § Routing model: the sentence on the one global docs route ("… resolves any doc regardless of which app you came from") loses "regardless of which app you came from". The same paragraph already says the viewer is **platform-level** and the URL is single-coordinate with no package or app prefix, so no meaning is lost. This pays for the "when it fits" qualifier. The react page § Safety / availability section is byte-identical to `main` (no hunk there).
- `.changeset/34228-print-section-per-block.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, because `skills/**` ships in that package. It also carries the two declaration lines.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measurement (dev report 6923091449): with the quote template split into one `record:details` block per section, an A4 zh-CN print leaves 4% of page 1 blank at 3 line rows and 18% at 6 rows; the unsplit template leaves 35% and 18%.
- The seat has posted the reporter reply on #34228. The template follow-up in HotCRM is hotcrm#2553 (p1). A long `record:line_items` table that moves whole to the next sheet is a separate card, #34427, which this ruling does not cover and this PR does not touch.
- Lands as Tier H: one `skills/**` path makes the PR Tier H.
